title: Web Summit schedule, filtered to press conferences, page 3 (Web Summit)
what_it_says: Page 3 of Web Summit's schedule filtered to the format 'Press conference', read at 02:34 UTC on 11 November 2026: session titles, start and end times, stage and speakers. The four pages list 23 sessions; the listing carries no notice about the Day 2 call-off. Read again at 12:33 UTC on 11 November (after Web Summit announced it is back on Thursday with sessions rescheduled from Wednesday): the same 23 sessions, none moved, added or removed; Wednesday's nine are still listed. Read again at 14:33 UTC on 11 November: still the same 23 sessions, none moved, added or removed. Read again at 16:33 UTC on 11 November: still the same 23 sessions, none moved, added or removed.
